messages:
maria_cs: Quick recap from the bridge with Nimbus — they flagged potential renewal risk if we can't get p50 latency under 250ms for their bursty inference workload. They want a short SLA/SLO plan + evidence bundle by EOD Friday.
aj_reliability: ok saw that. Their tail latency spikes are mostly on ~1024 token requests, and we saw KV cache misses on the dedicated pool. I can run a quick perf sweep today.
sam_onboarding: noted — Nimbus onboarding is at 72% (docs complete, test prompts in staging). They're asking for a playbook we can hand to their infra team for replaying the issue.
devon_sales: can we quantify renewal risk? Customer asked for explicit credit numbers if we miss SLO, they have a contract clause for latency credits.
maria_cs: yes — they want the SLO alignment doc + a mapping of observed windows -> credit calc. We should avoid surprises in renewal comms.
aj_reliability: propose temporary canary routing to a quantized variant for burst windows while we fix the cache knobs. That buys time without changing SLA. Thoughts?
olivia_enablement: I can draft the playbook and a one-page troubleshooting runbook for their infra folks. Will include commands and logs to gather. Example snippet:
```
# gather latency traces
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/metrics?customer=nimbus
# sample kvcache hit rate
redis-cli HGET kvcache:nimbus hit_rate
```
maria_cs: perfect. Add a section on evidence packaging (what we need for credit disputes).
aj_reliability: action items from my side: 1) run perf sweep on dedicated pool (ETA 3pm) 2) enable temporary canary route (need approval) 3) collect KV cache metrics and create a short dashboard.
sam_onboarding: my tasks: finish replay test harness (ETA EOD), record a short video of repro steps for Nimbus infra, and add the runbook links to the onboarding workspace.
devon_sales: I'll draft the customer-facing note about the SLO proposal and the credit calculation table. Can you confirm the formula?
maria_cs: credit formula we discussed with legal: uptime/latency credit = pro-rata credit based on missed p50 windows * contract multiplier. We'll include an example. Devon, I'll send you the legal-approved wording in 1h.
olivia_enablement: putting together the playbook doc in the shared drive: https://redwood.internal/docs/nimbus-playbook (will update with commands & logs).
opsbot: deploy-bot: Canary route config applied to cluster "dedicated-us-east-1" by aj_reliability at 14:34 UTC :white_check_mark:
aj_reliability: canary rolled out to 10% traffic. Initial p50 improved ~30ms in staging. Need to watch for regressions.
maria_cs: good progress. Next steps: finalize evidence bundle template (maria_cs), perf report + dashboard (aj_reliability), replay video + runbook (sam_onboarding), customer note + credit calc (devon_sales), enablement doc (olivia_enablement). Target: draft bundle by Friday 18:00 PT.
devon_sales: ack — will sync with legal and have the customer note ready for review by Thursday.
sam_onboarding: will post the replay link here when ready.
aj_reliability: will add a short changelog to the dashboard so the CS team can trace improvements.
maria_cs: thanks team. If anything blocks, @devon_sales loop legal earlier. I'll schedule a 30m follow-up on Thursday 10:00 PT to review the bundle before we send to Nimbus. :calendar: :white_check_mark:
